title: HS60014: Emotional Intelligence At Work
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Course Content
Nature, function and types of intelligence; Emotion, intelligence and
creativity; Growth and development of emotional intelligence; Theories and
models of emotional intelligence: ability based model, personality based model,
performance based model, mixed model; Culture, leadership and emotional
intelligence, assessments and evaluation of EI, application of EI in work and
personal life; Future directions of EI in research and deployment.
